name: Labrador Retriever
summary: A sturdy, friendly retriever in black, yellow, or chocolate. One of the most commonly seen dogs on any walk.
traits: Broad head with kind, expressive eyes

name: Golden Retriever
summary: A friendly retriever with a feathered golden coat. Easy to confuse with a Goldendoodle at a distance.
traits: Dense, feathered coat in shades of gold
Feathering on chest, legs, and tail
Straight to wavy coat, never tightly curled
Broad head with a friendly expression

name: Brittany
summary: A compact, leggy bird dog, usually orange-and-white or liver-and-white, with endless energy.
traits: Orange/white or liver/white coat, often ticked or roan

name: Beagle
summary: A small scent hound with a tri-color coat and a nose that leads the way (and a famously loud voice).

name: Dachshund
summary: A long-bodied, short-legged hound bred to follow badgers underground. Smooth, wirehaired, and longhaired varieties exist.
traits: Very long body on very short legs
Smooth, wire, or long coat varieties
Deep chest and a bold, confident stance

name: Rhodesian Ridgeback
summary: A muscular, wheaten-colored hound named for the ridge of backward-growing hair along its spine.
traits: A ridge of hair along the back growing against the coat
Muscular, athletic build with a deep chest
Dark muzzle and ears on many dogs

name: Siberian Husky
summary: A medium-sized sled dog with a thick double coat, upright ears, and often striking blue or mismatched eyes.
traits: Face mask markings and often blue or bi-colored eyes
Brush-like tail often carried in a sickle curve

name: Bernese Mountain Dog
summary: A large, tri-color farm dog with a long silky coat and a gentle, sturdy presence.
traits: Tri-color: black with rust and white markings
White blaze on face and white chest cross

name: Akita
summary: A large, powerful spitz-type dog with a broad head, small ears, and a thick tail curled over the back.
traits: Thick tail curled over the back
Heavy-boned, powerful build with a dense double coat

name: Parson Russell Terrier
summary: A leggy, mostly white terrier with tan or black markings, bred to follow foxes into the earth.
traits: Mostly white coat with tan or black markings
Longer legs than a Jack Russell-type 'Russell Terrier'

name: West Highland White Terrier
summary: A small, all-white Scottish terrier with a shaggy coat and a round, alert face.

name: Skye Terrier
summary: A very long, low terrier with a floor-length silky coat that parts down the back. Rarely seen outside shows.
traits: Long, straight, silky coat that nearly touches the ground
Hair falls over the eyes and forms a fringe
Ears either prick or drop, both feathered

name: Chihuahua
summary: The smallest breed of dog, with a rounded 'apple' head and big upright ears. Coats may be smooth or long.
traits: Smooth or long coat in any color

name: Yorkshire Terrier
summary: A tiny terrier with a long, silky blue-and-tan coat, often with a topknot bow.
traits: Steel blue body with tan face and chest

name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
summary: A small, silky spaniel with a sweet expression, long ears, and four recognized color patterns.
traits: Large, dark, round eyes with a sweet expression
Four colors: Blenheim, tricolor, ruby, black and tan

name: French Bulldog
summary: A compact, muscular dog with a flat face and signature 'bat' ears. Very common in city neighborhoods.

name: Dalmatian
summary: A muscular, athletic dog with a white coat covered in black or liver spots.
traits: White coat with round black or liver spots
Spots extend over the ears and legs

name: Xoloitzcuintli
summary: An ancient Mexican breed, usually hairless with smooth skin, a long neck, and large bat-like ears. A coated variety also exists.
traits: Hairless (most) with smooth skin, sometimes a short tuft
Long neck and lean, elegant body
Comes in toy, miniature, and standard sizes

name: Border Collie
summary: A highly intelligent, athletic herding dog, famous for its intense 'eye' and typical black-and-white coat.
traits: Usually black and white, often with a white blaze and collar
Medium build, athletic, built to move

name: Pembroke Welsh Corgi
summary: A short-legged herding dog with a fox-like face, upright ears, and a trademark fluffy rear.
traits: Red, sable, fawn, or tricolor with white markings

name: German Shepherd Dog
summary: A versatile, athletic herding dog widely used in police and service work, with a black-and-tan saddle pattern.
traits: Black saddle on tan, or all black or sable

name: Goldendoodle
summary: A popular cross of Golden Retriever and Poodle, with a wavy-to-curly teddy-bear coat. Sizes and looks vary widely.
traits: Wavy to curly coat, often cream, gold, or apricot
Coat varies from litter to litter
Often groomed in a rounded 'teddy bear' cut
Floppy ears and a long, feathered face

name: Labradoodle
summary: A cross of Labrador Retriever and Poodle with a curly or wavy coat. Looks vary from poodle-like to lab-like.
traits: Curly to wavy coat, in many colors
Often a longer, squared muzzle than a Goldendoodle

name: Cockapoo
summary: A small cross of Cocker Spaniel and Poodle with a soft, wavy to curly coat and long, rounded ears.

name: Mixed breed
summary: A dog of mixed or unknown heritage. Every one is one of a kind.
traits: Often shows traits of several breeds
Add a note on what you notice, it's good practice for breed spotting
